title: Peru Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Historical indicators through 2019; climate and development projections to 2050 and 2100
methodology: World Bank synthesis of climate, socioeconomic and institutional diagnostics with referenced quantitative estimates.
limitations: Dated 2022 with mixed indicator vintages; a national development report, not a conflict study, and attribution varies by estimate.

title: Peru: Strategic Actions Toward Water Security
temporal_coverage: Diagnostic studies conducted 2019–2021; model projections for 2030 and 2050
methodology: Water-security diagnostic using local hydrological data, satellite evapotranspiration, demand databases and SENAMHI climate projections.
limitations: Mixed study vintages and model assumptions; basin deficits are not 2026 measurements, and conflict discussion does not establish climate attribution.

title: Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas y Peligros Asociados 2025–2027
organization: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros (PCM), with CENEPRED
geographic_coverage: Peru; district risk scenarios and multisector interventions
temporal_coverage: Plan period 2025–2027; susceptibility analysis draws on historical El Niño/La Niña episodes and records through April 2024
methodology: Government risk plan combines hazard susceptibility, district exposure and vulnerability with agency intervention targets.
limitations: ENSO-based risk scenario is not an event forecast or anthropogenic attribution; intervention targets are not verified delivery outcomes.

title: Informe N.º 12-2025-OGASA: Conflictos socioambientales, diciembre 2025
organization: Ministerio del Ambiente (MINAM), Oficina General de Asuntos Socio-Ambientales (OGASA)
geographic_coverage: Peru; named socio-environmental cases in Puno and other regions
temporal_coverage: December 2025 monthly monitoring; annual alert totals through December 2025
methodology: Official monthly administrative monitoring of socio-environmental cases, alerts and agency commitments.
limitations: Agency case and commitment records are not independent verification, climate attribution or impact evaluation.

title: Follow the Water: Emerging Issues of Climate Change and Conflict in Peru
organization: Foundation for Environmental Security and Sustainability (FESS), prepared for USAID Office of Conflict Management and Mitigation
geographic_coverage: Santa River Basin and Huaraz, Ancash
methodology: Original field interviews in Lima, Huaraz/Santa River Basin and highland Arequipa.
limitations: 2012 discussion paper expressly not official USAID; qualitative interviews, no causal evaluation.
